name: Merrymask
lore: A wooden theatre puppet who snaps crossed strings, calls understudies and closes the curtain on enemies.

primary.name: String Scissors
primary.description: Cross two puppet strings at an aimed spot 85 away. After 0.18s the crossing snaps for 24 damage in a 42-radius area. Walls block it.

secondary.name: Understudies
secondary.description: Summon two 30-HP melee puppets for 8s, at most four. Each hits for 5 damage per second.

special.name: Curtain Call
special.description: A curtain sweeps closed after 0.6s. Deal 30 damage and stun for 1s; nearby puppets gain 20% protection for 3s.

passive: Shared Applause: a String Scissors hit restores 2 HP to each nearby puppet (not the hero).

technique.name: Broad Stitches

attack.name: Broad Stitches
attack.description: Cross two puppet strings at an aimed spot 85 away. After 0.18s the crossing snaps for 24 damage in a 42-radius area. Walls block it.

technique.description: Cover a wider crossing, for lower damage and slower recovery.

final_technique.name: Travelling Stage

attack.name: Travelling Stage
attack.description: Summon a 75-HP stage guardian for 8s. It hits for 12 per second; replaces the stun curtain.

final_technique.description: Trade the immediate stun and burst for a temporary melee guardian.
